skill_name: Write a commentary on the statement: "Online learning is the future of education".
workflow: The statement "Online learning is the future of education" is one that signals a major shift in the way education is delivered in the modern world. With the continuing progress of technology, more and more individuals are finding that they are better served by the convenience, flexibility and affordability of online learning.
